notes.title: I Know What You Fixed Last Summer
notes.content:
Yikes, sorry about that title. I should have gone with [i]Ghost In The Shell Script[/i]. Actually, shh, forget I said that, I'll use it another time.

Ok here's whats new!

- Not a lot.

- New Autosave in Day 5 (at the start of the third/final round of questioning) (did you know Day 5 is a murder mystery?! because it [i]so[/i] is.)

- Cleaned up some code in Day 5 that prevents a rare issue when questioning Pendleton (thank you PsyD Mom!)

- One time, the word Irish was said and it wasn't capitalized. So. Now it is.

- Another time, there was an extra "a" in a sentence. And now it's not.

Oh! Something fun! There's a super cool Player's Guide/Companion to all the must-see moments in the game and it's now included in the PC version's game folder! It can also be found on the website:

[url=https://thephantomfellows.com/companion]Player’s Guide- Can’t-Miss Companion to The Phantom Fellows[/url]

Also, while I strongly recommend you instead use the in-game hint system, there is an [url=https://thephantomfellows.com/walkthrough]official walkthrough[/url] on the website as well!

Finally, if you enjoyed your time with my game and haven't already, I'd greatly appreciate a positive review, it really helps out a solo dev like myself :)

And as always, thank you for playing [i]The Phantom Fellows[/i]!

notes.title: Ghost Portraits by Olan Mills
notes.content:
Are we... did that Olan Mills reference land? Here, I'll explain it into being funny, see they were the quintessential 80's family portrait people and this build has [b]all new ghost portraits[/b] so that's why, well, that's the why.

I regret going this route.

But I'd hate to waste a whole, terrible paragraph so on with the show!

- Fixed an uncommon bug in Day 4 that caused a crash 

- Fixed a single spelling error (I'llll never tell) (teehee)

- Sorry about that teehee up there

- Intro music over the menu lowered [i]yet again[/i] I think I've lowered it a few in every single update and it was still a little loud for streamers 

- Added more direction and clarity to the opening dialog in Day 5, should a player try to leave before briefing is completed

- Finally, the ghost's have new portraits and I think they look ah-mazing, shek 'em out!

And as always, thank you for playing ([u]and leaving a positive review for[/u]) [i]The Phantom Fellows[/i]!

To Access a beta branch:
1. Go to your Library.
2. Right-click The Phantom Fellows and select "Properties."
3. Click on the "Betas" tab.
4. From the dropdown, select the branch named "previous_version".
5. Steam will automatically update the game to the selected branch.
